intro: Two things move across the study: which interconnectors get built, and what the EU pays for power at the border. A scenario is one choice on each axis, so a project scenario must be read against the counterfactual that shares its price path — not against the central baseline.

LC_Baseline.title: Baseline
LC_Baseline.summary: The counterfactual. Existing cross-border capacity only, no new interconnector to the EU, no new line inside the region, EU border prices on the central path.
detail: pExtTransferLimit_baseline.csv holds the corridors that already exist; pNewTransmission_none.csv offers the model no internal candidate to build.
Every project scenario on the central price path is read against this one.

LC_Iso.title: Isolation
LC_Iso.summary: Every zone on its own: internal transfer limits zeroed and trade with the external zones switched off.
detail: pTransferLimit_iso.csv and pSettings_iso.csv. Not a plan — the bound on what integration can be worth, and the case where scarcity shows up as price spikes.

LC_60pct.title: 60% reinforcement
LC_60pct.summary: The existing Turkiye–EU corridors reinforced: +1 360 MW to Bulgaria and +680 MW to Greece from 2027, 816 M$ of capex. No new corridor.

LC_BSSC.title: Black Sea Submarine Cable
LC_BSSC.summary: Phase 1 of the Georgia–Romania submarine cable: 1 300 MW from 2031, 3 500 M$.
detail: The cable is the only route that sells Caucasus power into the EU without crossing Turkiye, so most of its value lands in Georgia.

LC_GECO.title: GECO — full cable
LC_GECO.summary: The Georgia–Romania corridor at full size: 5 200 MW from 2031, 14 000 M$. Contains BSSC phase 1 as its first phase.

LC_EWTC.title: East–West Transmission Corridor
LC_EWTC.summary: 775 MW Trakia–Bulgaria from 2033 and 775 MW Trakia–Greece from 2034, 500 M$ together.

LC_TransCaspian.title: Trans-Caspian
LC_TransCaspian.summary: 1 000 MW between Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan across the Caspian from 2035, 2 000 M$.

LC_BSTN.title: BSTN — EastAna–Georgia
LC_BSTN.summary: The Turkiye–Georgia line committed: 350 MW from 2032, 850 M$. External capacity unchanged.

LC_Zangezur.title: Zangezur — Nakhchivan–EastAna
LC_Zangezur.summary: The Nakhchivan–Turkiye line committed: 1 000 MW from 2032, 1 450 M$.

LC_CTN.title: CTN — Georgia–Armenia
LC_CTN.summary: The Georgia–Armenia line committed: 350 MW from 2029, 850 M$.

LC_AllProjects.title: All projects
LC_AllProjects.summary: Everything at once: GECO 5 200 MW to Romania, EWTC 2×775 MW to Bulgaria and Greece, Trans-Caspian 1 000 MW, and the three regional lines committed. 16 500 M$ of external capex.

LC_FreeExpProjects.title: Regional lines as candidates
LC_FreeExpProjects.summary: The three regional lines offered to the model rather than committed: it builds them only if they pay for themselves.

LC_FreeExpNational.title: Free expansion — inside Turkiye
LC_FreeExpNational.summary: Every internal Turkish corridor gets up to ten 1 000 MW candidates from 2028; the cross-border lines stay out.

LC_FreeExpCrossBorder.title: Free expansion — regional borders
LC_FreeExpCrossBorder.summary: The regional borders opened to candidates: up to 6 lines EastAna–Georgia, 6 Georgia–Armenia, 3 Nakhchivan–EastAna, 4 Azerbaijan–Georgia.

LC_FreeExpAll.title: Free expansion — everything
LC_FreeExpAll.summary: Both free-expansion sets at once: what the region would build if internal capacity were free to choose. A benchmark, not a plan.

LC_TRGasFlat.title: Turkish gas flat
LC_TRGasFlat.summary: Turkish gas at a flat 10 $/MMBtu. That path became the study default on 2026-08-25, so this scenario now reproduces the baseline and is kept only for provenance.

LC_Base_VeryLow.title: Baseline · very low EU prices
LC_Base_VeryLow.summary: The baseline grid, with the EU border price on the very-low path. The counterfactual for every project scenario run at very-low prices.

LC_Base_Low.title: Baseline · low EU prices
LC_Base_Low.summary: The baseline grid on the low EU price path.

LC_Base_High.title: Baseline · high EU prices
LC_Base_High.summary: The baseline grid on the high EU price path.

LC_Base_Crisis.title: Baseline · crisis prices
LC_Base_Crisis.summary: The baseline grid on the crisis price path — a repeat of the 2022 kind of shock. The counterfactual for project scenarios run at crisis prices.

LC_Base_CBAM.title: Baseline · CBAM on exports
LC_Base_CBAM.summary: Central import prices, but exports to the EU pay the carbon border adjustment. It takes most of the margin out of Turkish exports.
detail: Only the export price file changes (pTradePriceExport_eu_central_cbam.csv): what the region pays to import is untouched.

LC_Base_VeryLowCBAM.title: Baseline · very low + CBAM
LC_Base_VeryLowCBAM.summary: Very-low import prices with the carbon border adjustment on exports.

LC_Base_LowCBAM.title: Baseline · low + CBAM
LC_Base_LowCBAM.summary: Low import prices with the carbon border adjustment on exports.

LC_Base_HighCBAM.title: Baseline · high + CBAM
LC_Base_HighCBAM.summary: High import prices with the carbon border adjustment on exports.

LC_Base_CrisisCBAM.title: Baseline · crisis + CBAM
LC_Base_CrisisCBAM.summary: Crisis import prices with the carbon border adjustment on exports.

LC_BSSC_VeryLow.title: BSSC · very low EU prices
LC_BSSC_VeryLow.summary: The submarine cable on the very-low price path. Read against LC_Base_VeryLow: a benefit only means something against the same prices.

LC_BSSC_Crisis.title: BSSC · crisis prices
LC_BSSC_Crisis.summary: The submarine cable on the crisis price path.

LC_BSSC_CBAM.title: BSSC · CBAM on exports
LC_BSSC_CBAM.summary: The submarine cable when exports to the EU pay the carbon border adjustment.

LC_AllProjects_VeryLow.title: All projects · very low EU prices
LC_AllProjects_VeryLow.summary: The full project set on the very-low price path.

LC_AllProjects_Crisis.title: All projects · crisis prices
LC_AllProjects_Crisis.summary: The full project set on the crisis price path.

LC_AllProjects_CBAM.title: All projects · CBAM on exports
LC_AllProjects_CBAM.summary: The full project set when exports to the EU pay the carbon border adjustment.

LC_FreeExpAll_VeryLow.title: Free expansion · very low EU prices
LC_FreeExpAll_VeryLow.summary: The unconstrained-grid benchmark on the very-low price path.

LC_FreeExpAll_Crisis.title: Free expansion · crisis prices
LC_FreeExpAll_Crisis.summary: The unconstrained-grid benchmark on the crisis price path.

LC_FreeExpAll_CBAM.title: Free expansion · CBAM on exports
LC_FreeExpAll_CBAM.summary: The unconstrained-grid benchmark when exports pay the carbon border adjustment.
